chapter.title: No Refunds
chapter.subtitle: One good deed. One very bad purchase.
chapter.description: Anunaki Arrival · Chapter 1. One good deed. One very bad purchase.

tips: Complete the chapter to advance. Optional stars never block the next chapter.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Time machine. Low mileage. One previous century. Cash only.

scenes.speaker: Captain Jigga
scenes.text: Yasuke, you said you wanted a way home. Your actual home. I found us a ride.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: You found a washing machine with a steering wheel.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Deluxe model. Spin cycle is how it handles leap years.

scenes.speaker: Captain Jigga
scenes.text: Set the year, hit return. How hard could that be?

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Jigga. Why does RETURN have a minus sign?

tips: Utu creates a Tablet in an empty enemy district. Play your temporary Utu to begin the engine.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.name: Ancient Field
passive.description: Utu creates a Tablet in an empty enemy district. Play your temporary Utu to begin the engine.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Utu
preDialogue.text: An unregistered vessel just tore through our descent corridor. Put your hands where the sun can see them.

preDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
preDialogue.text: Officer, this vehicle is technically an appliance.

postDialogue.speaker: Utu
postDialogue.text: You can hold a line. That does not explain the machine.

postDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
postDialogue.text: Then let us explain before your ships arrive on top of it.

preDialogue.speaker: Nabu
preDialogue.text: The arrival registry has every name except yours.

postDialogue.speaker: Nabu
postDialogue.text: Your coordinates point to a city that does not exist.

postDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
postDialogue.text: Not yet. That is the difficulty.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

scenes.speaker: Nabu
scenes.text: The machine left a readable sequence in its dial. Correct the sequence before trying another jump.

puzzle.title: Which Way Is Home?
puzzle.instruction: Reconstruct the machine’s launch sequence. The battery connects before the dial can light. The dial lights before a destination is entered. RETURN is pressed last.

pieces.label: Enter destination
pieces.detail: The date entry requires the lit dial.

pieces.label: Connect battery
pieces.detail: The cable powers the control panel.

pieces.label: Press RETURN
pieces.detail: The label says “earlier,” in very small print.

hints: Follow the power before the destination.
puzzle.solvedText: The sequence worked. The RETURN switch subtracts the entered year instead of traveling to it. The machine overshot by millennia.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew works through the clues with you. You continue with the same story progress and rewards.

tips: Hold both outside districts for a mastery star. Winning alone advances the story.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.description: Hold both outside districts for a mastery star. Winning alone advances the story.

preDialogue.speaker: Utu
preDialogue.text: The left and right beacons are jammed. Clear both before the next vessel lands.

preDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
preDialogue.text: We caused the breach. We will make room.

postDialogue.speaker: Utu
postDialogue.text: Beacons clear. Nobody beneath the hull. Good.

postDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
postDialogue.text: Already doing community service in a century with no community yet.

tips: Spend Motion on two districts before committing your finisher. Utu weakens the strongest enemy in an occupied lane.

preDialogue.speaker: Utu
preDialogue.text: One final check. Show me you can move through the landing field without wrecking it.

preDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
preDialogue.text: My insurance provider is going to have a spiritual experience.

postDialogue.speaker: Utu
postDialogue.text: Go inland. A scientist named Yakub studies impossible things.

postDialogue.speaker: Utu
postDialogue.text: He keeps the pieces. Ask him that first.

scenes.speaker: Captain Jigga
scenes.text: We missed your century by a little.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: There are ships building the horizon. Define a little.

scenes.speaker: Captain Jigga
scenes.text: We can still fix it. Yakub first. Then your home.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: Your offer mattered, Jigga. Next time, read the controls.
